title: The machine that cleans the ice

sentences.text: At a hockey game there is a break.
A big slow machine comes out.
It drives around the ice.
Children watch it more than the game.
sentences.translationRu: Дети смотрят на неё больше, чем на игру.

sentences.text: It has a name. It is a Zamboni.
A man called Frank Zamboni made the first one.
sentences.translationRu: Первую сделал человек по имени Фрэнк Замбони.

sentences.text: He had an ice rink in America.
sentences.translationRu: У него был каток в Америке.

sentences.text: Cleaning the ice took five men.
And more than an hour.
So he built a machine instead.
sentences.translationRu: И он вместо этого построил машину.

sentences.text: It does three things at once.
First it cuts.
A long blade takes off the top of the ice.
sentences.translationRu: Длинный нож снимает верхний слой льда.

sentences.text: Skates make deep lines and small pieces.
sentences.translationRu: Коньки оставляют борозды и мелкую крошку.

sentences.text: All of that has to go.
The machine collects it in a big box.
sentences.translationRu: Машина собирает это в большой бункер.

sentences.text: One cleaning can take two tonnes of snow.
sentences.translationRu: За одну чистку набирается до двух тонн снега.

sentences.text: Second it washes.
It puts water down and takes it back.
sentences.translationRu: Она льёт воду и тут же забирает.

sentences.text: This takes the dirt out of the lines.
Third it puts new water down.
A very thin layer, behind a cloth.
The cloth spreads it flat.
The water is hot, which surprises people.
Hot water makes better ice.
It has less air in it.
Air makes ice white and soft.
sentences.translationRu: Воздух делает лёд белым и мягким.

sentences.text: Less air means harder, clearer ice.
sentences.translationRu: Меньше воздуха — твёрже и прозрачнее лёд.

sentences.text: The new water freezes in a few minutes.
sentences.translationRu: Новая вода замерзает за несколько минут.

sentences.text: So the ice is perfect again.
The whole rink is only a few centimetres thick.
sentences.translationRu: Весь каток всего в несколько сантиметров толщиной.

sentences.text: Under it there are pipes with cold liquid.
sentences.translationRu: Под ним трубы с холодной жидкостью.

sentences.text: Kilometres of them, under the floor.
Frank Zamboni never sold many machines.
sentences.translationRu: Фрэнк Замбони продал не так много машин.

sentences.text: There are not many ice rinks.
But everybody knows his name.

title: Why a skater spins faster with her arms in

sentences.text: A figure skater begins to spin.
Her arms are out wide.
She is turning slowly.
Then she pulls her arms in.
And she speeds up.
A lot. Suddenly. Without pushing.
Nothing gave her more energy.
She is not touching anything.
sentences.translationRu: Она ни за что не держится.

sentences.text: The ice is smooth under her.
So where does the speed come from?
There is a rule about spinning things.
A spinning thing keeps its spin.
Unless something stops it.
But spin is two things together.
sentences.translationRu: Но вращение — это две вещи вместе.

sentences.text: How fast you turn.
And how far your weight is from the middle.
sentences.translationRu: И как далеко твоя масса от центра.

sentences.text: Those two multiply to a fixed number.
sentences.translationRu: Эти два перемножаются в постоянное число.

sentences.text: If one goes down, the other must go up.
sentences.translationRu: Если одно уменьшается, второе должно вырасти.

sentences.text: Arms out means weight is far away.
So the turning must be slow.
Arms in means weight is close.
So the turning must be fast.
She did not add anything.
She moved it closer.
This works everywhere, not only on ice.
sentences.translationRu: Это работает везде, не только на льду.

sentences.text: Sit on a chair that turns.
Push off with your legs out.
Then pull your legs in.
You will feel it immediately.
Divers use the same thing.
sentences.translationRu: Прыгуны в воду пользуются тем же.

sentences.text: They curl up to turn fast.
Then open out to stop turning.
And enter the water straight.
A star does it too.
When a very big star falls in on itself,
it becomes small and turns very fast.
sentences.translationRu: она становится маленькой и крутится очень быстро.

sentences.text: Some turn hundreds of times a second.
sentences.translationRu: Некоторые делают сотни оборотов в секунду.

sentences.text: The same rule as the skater.
sentences.translationRu: То же правило, что у фигуристки.

title: Why the room keeps turning after you stop

sentences.text: Spin around ten times and stop.
The room keeps turning.
You know it is not.
It does anyway.
The reason is inside your ear.
Behind the part you hear with
there are three small tubes.
They are bent into rings.
And they are full of liquid.
Each ring lies in a different direction.
sentences.translationRu: Каждое кольцо лежит в своём направлении.

sentences.text: So together they cover every way you can turn.
sentences.translationRu: Вместе они покрывают все способы повернуться.

sentences.text: Inside each ring there are tiny hairs.
When your head turns, the liquid moves.
Or rather, it stays still at first.
sentences.translationRu: Точнее, сначала она остаётся на месте.

sentences.text: The head moves around it.
So the hairs are pushed.
The brain reads that as turning.
Now spin for a long time.
The liquid catches up.
It starts turning with you.
sentences.translationRu: Она начинает вращаться вместе с тобой.

sentences.text: The hairs go straight again.
So you stop feeling the spin.
Then you stop.
Your head stops immediately.
The liquid does not.
It keeps going for a few seconds.
Now it is moving and you are not.
sentences.translationRu: Теперь она движется, а ты нет.

sentences.text: The hairs bend the other way.
And the brain says: we are turning.
Your eyes say: we are not.
Two systems, two answers.
That disagreement is what dizziness is.
It is also why you feel sick.
The brain has an old rule for this.
sentences.translationRu: У мозга на такой случай старое правило.

sentences.text: When the senses disagree, something is wrong.
sentences.translationRu: Если чувства спорят — что-то не так.

sentences.text: Possibly poison. So: get rid of it.
Dancers have a trick against all this.
sentences.translationRu: У танцоров против всего этого есть приём.

sentences.text: They keep their eyes on one point.
sentences.translationRu: Они держат взгляд на одной точке.

sentences.text: Then turn the head fast at the end.
sentences.translationRu: И в конце быстро доворачивают голову.

sentences.text: The liquid never settles into a turn.
sentences.translationRu: Жидкость просто не успевает войти во вращение.

title: No two football pitches are the same size

sentences.text: A tennis court is one size everywhere.
So is a basketball court.
So is an Olympic pool.
A football pitch is not.
The rules give a range, not a number.
sentences.translationRu: Правила задают диапазон, а не число.

sentences.text: A pitch may be from ninety metres long
sentences.translationRu: Поле может быть от девяноста метров в длину

sentences.text: to a hundred and twenty.
And from forty-five to ninety wide.
sentences.translationRu: И от сорока пяти до девяноста в ширину.

sentences.text: Those are enormous differences.
The largest allowed pitch
is nearly three times the area of the smallest.
sentences.translationRu: почти втрое больше по площади, чем самое маленькое.

sentences.text: Only the goal is fixed.
And the penalty area, and the spot.
Everything else is a choice.
And clubs do choose.
A team that passes the ball quickly
wants a wide pitch.
Space is what their style needs.
sentences.translationRu: Пространство — это то, что нужно их стилю.

sentences.text: A team that defends and presses
wants a narrow one.
Less space means fewer passing options.
And a press works better in a small box.
sentences.translationRu: А прессинг в тесной коробке работает лучше.

sentences.text: Some clubs have changed their pitch
when a new manager arrived.
Within the rules, quietly, in one summer.
sentences.translationRu: В рамках правил, тихо, за одно лето.

sentences.text: Grass is a choice too.
It can be cut short and watered heavily.
sentences.translationRu: Его можно стричь коротко и обильно поливать.

sentences.text: Which makes the ball run fast.
Or left longer and drier, to slow it.
sentences.translationRu: Или оставить длиннее и суше, чтобы замедлить.

sentences.text: Both are legal. Both are used.
sentences.translationRu: И то и другое законно. И то и другое применяют.

sentences.text: Big competitions have tightened this.
They require one standard size now.
So the biggest games are on equal ground.
sentences.translationRu: Чтобы главные матчи шли на равном поле.

sentences.text: In domestic leagues it still varies.
Which makes football unusual.
Most sports made the field identical
so the result would be about the players.
Football left a piece of the field
as something a club is allowed to decide.
sentences.translationRu: тем, что клуб вправе решать сам.

title: Somebody is paid to name the colours

sentences.text: Go into a shop and look at paint.
sentences.translationRu: Зайди в магазин и посмотри на краску.

sentences.text: Hundreds of small cards.
Every one has a name on it.
Not a code. A name.
Morning Fog. Elephant's Breath.
Somebody wrote those.
It is a real job.
A company may need two hundred names a year.
sentences.translationRu: Компании может понадобиться двести названий в год.

sentences.text: And the rules are stricter than they look.
A name cannot be a colour word alone.
sentences.translationRu: Название не может быть просто словом-цветом.

sentences.text: Grey does not sell.
Fifty greys sit next to each other on a wall.
sentences.translationRu: Пятьдесят серых стоят рядом на стенде.

sentences.text: They must be told apart by feeling.
So the name does the separating.
It also has to travel.
A name is translated into many languages.
A joke that works in one dies in another.
sentences.translationRu: Шутка, которая работает в одном, умирает в другом.

sentences.text: And some words carry a bad meaning somewhere.
sentences.translationRu: А некоторые слова где-то несут дурной смысл.

sentences.text: Companies keep lists of words to avoid.
sentences.translationRu: У компаний есть списки запретных слов.

sentences.text: It has to be legally free.
sentences.translationRu: И название должно быть юридически свободным.

sentences.text: Names are checked against trademarks.
A good one is often already owned.
And it must match what people expect
sentences.translationRu: И оно должно совпадать с тем, чего люди ждут

sentences.text: from a colour they cannot quite describe.
sentences.translationRu: от цвета, который они не могут описать.

sentences.text: Researchers have tested this.
Show two identical colours with different names.
sentences.translationRu: Покажи два одинаковых цвета под разными именами.

sentences.text: People rate them differently.
They prefer the one with the better name.
sentences.translationRu: И выберут тот, у которого название лучше.

sentences.text: They also describe it differently.
Warmer, or calmer, or more expensive.
The paint has not changed.
Namers describe the work in the same way.
sentences.translationRu: Те, кто их придумывает, описывают работу одинаково.

sentences.text: They are not naming a colour.
They are naming a room that does not exist yet.
sentences.translationRu: Они называют комнату, которой ещё нет.

sentences.text: The customer is not buying grey.
They are buying the morning in the name.
sentences.translationRu: Он берёт то утро, которое в названии.

title: The rule that assumes nobody can be that fast

sentences.text: In a sprint, the gun goes and everybody runs.
sentences.translationRu: В спринте звучит выстрел, и все бегут.

sentences.text: Sometimes a runner is called back.
False start. Disqualified.
Often it looks like they moved after the gun.
sentences.translationRu: Часто кажется, что он стартовал после выстрела.

sentences.text: Sometimes clearly after it.
The rule is not about moving early.
It is about moving too soon after.
sentences.translationRu: Оно про слишком скорый старт после.

sentences.text: There are pressure sensors in the blocks.
They record the exact moment
a runner pushes back against them.
If that is less than a tenth of a second
sentences.translationRu: Если это меньше одной десятой секунды

sentences.text: after the gun, it is a false start.
Even if the runner was still in the blocks.
sentences.translationRu: Даже если бегун ещё был в колодках.

sentences.text: The reasoning is physiological.
Sound has to reach the ear.
Be turned into a nerve signal.
Reach the brain, be recognised,
and a command has to travel back to the legs.
sentences.translationRu: и команда должна уйти обратно к ногам.

sentences.text: Muscles then have to build force.
Laboratory measurements put the floor
at somewhere around a tenth of a second.
So a faster response is not a response.
sentences.translationRu: Значит, более быстрый отклик — не отклик.

sentences.text: It is a guess that happened to land well.
The rule exists to stop guessing paying off.
sentences.translationRu: Правило существует, чтобы угадывать не окупалось.

sentences.text: It is a rare thing in sport.
A rule built on a scientific limit
rather than on what a judge can see.
sentences.translationRu: а не на том, что может увидеть судья.

sentences.text: It has been argued about for years.
Some researchers say the floor is lower
sentences.translationRu: Некоторые исследователи говорят, что порог ниже

sentences.text: for elite athletes, perhaps considerably.
If so, the rule punishes the fastest reactors.
sentences.translationRu: Если так, правило наказывает самых быстрых.

sentences.text: Others say the measurement is contaminated
by tiny movements before the gun.
The current rule is also unforgiving.
One false start and you are out.
It used to be one per race, shared.
sentences.translationRu: Раньше один на забег полагался всем вместе.

sentences.text: Which runners used tactically.
Somebody would go early on purpose
to unsettle a rival, knowing it was free.
sentences.translationRu: чтобы сбить соперника, зная, что это бесплатно.

sentences.text: Television wanted races to start on time.
sentences.translationRu: Телевидению нужно было, чтобы забеги начинались вовремя.

sentences.text: So the free one was removed.
Which is how a broadcast schedule
ended up deciding a rule of the sport.

title: City animals are changing faster than country ones

sentences.text: A city looks like the opposite of nature.
Concrete, noise, light, people.
For a long time biologists treated it that way.
sentences.translationRu: Долго биологи так к нему и относились.

sentences.text: Somewhere life was pushed out of.
sentences.translationRu: Как к месту, откуда жизнь вытеснили.

sentences.text: The study of urban evolution
has turned that around.
A city is not an absence of an environment.
It is an extremely strong one.
With pressures unlike anything in a forest.
sentences.translationRu: С давлением, не похожим ни на что в лесу.

sentences.text: And selection is fast when pressure is strong.
sentences.translationRu: А при сильном давлении отбор идёт быстро.

sentences.text: The examples are specific and measurable.
Birds in noisy cities sing at a higher pitch.
sentences.translationRu: Птицы в шумных городах поют выше.

sentences.text: Traffic noise is concentrated in low tones.
sentences.translationRu: Транспортный шум сосредоточен в низких тонах.

sentences.text: A low song is simply not heard.
Populations have shifted upwards
within a few decades.
Some also sing earlier, before the traffic.
sentences.translationRu: Некоторые ещё и поют раньше, до потока машин.

sentences.text: Spiders near street lamps build larger webs
sentences.translationRu: Пауки у фонарей строят более крупные сети

sentences.text: and have lost their avoidance of light.
Which in a dark world would have been fatal.
sentences.translationRu: В тёмном мире это было бы гибельно.

sentences.text: Here it is where the food is.
Plants in cracks in pavements
produce heavier seeds that fall straight down.
sentences.translationRu: дают более тяжёлые семена, падающие прямо вниз.

sentences.text: A seed built to fly lands on concrete.
sentences.translationRu: Семя, созданное летать, садится на бетон.

sentences.text: A seed that drops stays in the crack.
sentences.translationRu: Семя, которое падает, остаётся в трещине.

sentences.text: That change has been measured
in a single species over about a decade.
sentences.translationRu: у одного вида примерно за десятилетие.

sentences.text: Behaviour changes even faster than bodies.
Urban birds are bolder and quicker to try new food.
sentences.translationRu: Городские птицы смелее и быстрее пробуют новую еду.

sentences.text: They solve novel problems more readily
than the same species outside the city.
sentences.translationRu: чем тот же вид за городом.

sentences.text: Which is not surprising in hindsight.
A city rewards animals that improvise
and punishes those following a fixed routine.
sentences.translationRu: и наказывает тех, кто следует жёсткому распорядку.

sentences.text: There is a useful corrective in all of it.
sentences.translationRu: Во всём этом есть полезная поправка.

sentences.text: Cities are not where nature is absent.
sentences.translationRu: Города — не там, где нет природы.

sentences.text: They are where it is being rewritten
faster than anywhere else on the planet.
And where, unusually, we can watch it happen
sentences.translationRu: И где, что редкость, мы можем наблюдать это

sentences.text: inside one human lifetime.

title: Famines happen in countries with food

sentences.text: The intuitive model of famine is shortage.
A harvest fails. There is not enough food.
People starve because there is nothing to eat.
sentences.translationRu: Люди голодают, потому что есть нечего.

sentences.text: The economist Amartya Sen examined
several major famines in detail.
And found that this was often not the case.
sentences.translationRu: И обнаружил, что часто это не так.

sentences.text: In some of them, food supply per person
sentences.translationRu: В некоторых из них снабжение едой на человека

sentences.text: was not meaningfully lower than in normal years.
sentences.translationRu: не было существенно ниже, чем в обычные годы.

sentences.text: In at least one it was higher.
sentences.translationRu: Как минимум в одном оно было выше.

sentences.text: Food was in the country the whole time.
sentences.translationRu: Еда была в стране всё это время.

sentences.text: Some of it was being exported
while people a few hundred miles away died.
sentences.translationRu: пока люди в нескольких сотнях километров умирали.

sentences.text: His argument is about access, not supply.
sentences.translationRu: Его довод — про доступ, а не про снабжение.

sentences.text: A person does not eat because food exists.
sentences.translationRu: Человек ест не потому, что еда существует.

sentences.text: They eat because they can command some of it.
sentences.translationRu: Он ест потому, что может ею распорядиться.

sentences.text: By growing it, buying it, or being given it.
Break any of those and hunger follows,
sentences.translationRu: Сломай любое из трёх — придёт голод,

sentences.text: with full warehouses in the same country.
sentences.translationRu: при полных складах в той же стране.

sentences.text: The mechanisms are unglamorous.
A rural labourer is paid in work, not crops.
sentences.translationRu: Сельский работник получает за труд, а не урожаем.

sentences.text: A bad season means nobody hires.
sentences.translationRu: Плохой сезон — значит никто не нанимает.

sentences.text: His income goes to zero
in the same weeks that prices rise.
sentences.translationRu: в те же недели, когда цены растут.

sentences.text: Not because food is scarce,
but because everybody is buying early
sentences.translationRu: а потому, что все закупаются заранее

sentences.text: in case it becomes scarce.
sentences.translationRu: на случай, если её станет мало.

sentences.text: Expectation moves the price
long before any shortage does.
Then comes the observation he is known for.
sentences.translationRu: И дальше — наблюдение, которым он известен.

sentences.text: No substantial famine has occurred
in a functioning democracy with a free press.
sentences.translationRu: в работающей демократии со свободной прессой.

sentences.text: The claim has been argued over
and the definitions matter a great deal.
But the mechanism he proposes is simple.
Famines are slow and visible.
A government that can be removed
acts on a problem it is being told about.
sentences.translationRu: реагирует на проблему, о которой ему говорят.

sentences.text: One that cannot is often not told.
sentences.translationRu: Тому, которое сместить нельзя, часто не говорят.

sentences.text: Which reframes the whole subject.
Hunger looks like a problem of agriculture.
It behaves like a problem of information
sentences.translationRu: А ведёт себя как проблема информации

sentences.text: and of who is allowed to make a claim on what exists.
sentences.translationRu: и того, кому позволено претендовать на существующее.
